extensionDescription.message: Jumps to the message on the clipboard: by subject in the current folder, with or without quotes, or by a mid: link across all folders. Repeating the command selects the next match. Double-click the subject to copy it in quotes, or Shift-double-click to copy the mid: link. The same actions can be assigned to shortcuts.

commandJump.message: Jump to the message on the clipboard

notifyNoMailTab.message: There is no open message list.

notifyError.message: Could not jump to the message.
